question: Does public BUB1B knockdown provide a reproducible expression signature, and does everolimus oppose it after cell-context and shared-growth-program sensitivity checks?
registration_scope: Fixed before opening expression values; dataset metadata, reagent counts and published signature QC were inspected. Earlier Track 2 conclusions are known. This is an exploratory public-data reanalysis, not a clinical validation or independent experiment.
integrity: Compare all provided upstream SHA512 hashes; record SHA256 and bytes. Reject nonfinite values and duplicate/mismatched identifiers. Exactly 978 directly measured landmarks; inferred features are excluded.

compound_universe.selection: All profiles retained. Primary comparisons match cell_id; doses and times remain separate. Cross-cell matrix is exploratory and never substitutes for missing matched context.

analyses: Rank-normalized landmark Spearman correlation for every BUB1B CGS versus every compound signature, retaining complete matrices.
Matched-context compound rankings and named-drug scores, per dose and time; metadata quality flag requires distil_nsample >= 3, distil_cc_q75 >= 0.2 and TAS >= 0.2. All failed profiles retained.
Rank-space sensitivity removing the first principal component of same-cell/time non-BUB1B shRNA profiles; do not label this a proven growth correction.

Rank-space sensitivity projecting out the span of available same-cell/time CGSs for the eight fixed proliferation/mitosis genes. Require >= 3 controls; this can remove genuine BUB1B biology and is only a specificity stress test.

Unique BUB1B shRNA reagent vectors (median across repeated signatures), target-transcript knockdown direction, all pairwise correlations, leave-one-reagent-out drug score ranges and all balanced half-splits (cap 1000 deterministically).

10000 same-cell/time non-BUB1B reagent-set resamples for split-half agreement, preserving complete gene vectors. Empirical tail area and BH across 14 contexts; not a clinical probability. Seed sequences and exact CGS membership are not verified.

All same-cell/time genetic CGSs versus matched-cell compound profiles for gene-specificity ranks and MTOR/RPTOR mechanism comparisons. These genes and profiles are dependent; empirical percentiles are descriptive, not p-values.

CPU float64 versus GPU float32 numerical comparison, TF32 disabled; maximum absolute correlation difference <= 2e-5. All eight explicitly assigned H100s process fixed context shards. Retain failures and all completed outputs.
decision_rules: Query-gate failure prevents a drug-ranking claim in that context; missing information is unknown rather than evidence of no drug effect.
A positive everolimus/BUB1B correlation contradicts expression-reversal support in that tested context, not all functional-benefit hypotheses.

A negative correlation is insufficient for rescue: require reproducible query, acceptable drug QC, consistency across relevant contexts, sensitivity checks and future direct function/safety measurements.
No pooled tumour/normal claim. ASC, NPC and immortalized HA1E are distinct model contexts; none is the child's tissue or selected allele pair.
No approved-drug promotion from an exploratory top hit, nominal culture concentration, correlation sign, empirical rank, GPU throughput or software pass.
Retain no rescue-priority drug, unknown clinical margins and unknown phase. Results can change experimental controls, model selection and the strength of the transcriptomic rationale.
limits: Knockdown is not the selected genotype
shRNA off-target and shared seed effects
CGS membership may differ from all available reagents
Compound availability and culture exposures are uneven
No measured growth or chromosome-segregation endpoint in this reanalysis
Pooled signature vectors are not independent biological replicates
protected_inputs: None; only public NIH data and analysis code. No new model API, credentials or subject content.
presentation: Preserve v18. Publish a separate v19 research addendum before any later presentation integration.
